thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - Dedicated reserved pool 'resv-east-1' reported 100% GPU utilization; queue growth detected for enterprise tenant AcmeHealth. Paging oncall.

eli (oncall): Got the page, looking. Can someone post the initial metrics?

maya: Grafana shows sustained 100% utilization on pool-resv-east-1 starting 11:22 UTC, queue length jumped from 12 -> 240 between 11:25-11:34.

jordan: Confirming autoscaler logs show failed scale attempts due to quota limit: "insufficient quota for node group" repeated.

zara (support): AcmeHealth reports elevated error rates in their integration. They say requests are timing out with 504s. Customer is on Reserved plan; high business impact.

eli (oncall): TL;DR: reserved GPUs full, autoscaler hit cloud quota, noisy neighbor VMs pegging a few machines. Immediate mitigation steps?

ops-tilly: I can evict a noisy tenant pod set from the reserved pool to free ~4 GPUs. Need approval. This will impact that tenant's latency.

sre-bot: Suggested action: 1) Enable emergency fallback routing for AcmeHealth to shared hosted cluster for up to 10% of traffic. 2) Evict noisy pods from resv pool. 3) Request quota bump with cloud provider.

eli (oncall): Approve eviction if it frees necessary capacity. Maya, can you identify which pods are the noisy neighbors?

maya: Yes — pods with label team=research-heavy on nodes node-23 and node-24 showing continuous 100% gpu_util and long-running jobs. Pod IDs: research-heavy-7b9f, research-heavy-8c2d.

eli (oncall): ops-tilly go ahead evict research-heavy-7b9f and research-heavy-8c2d from the reserved pool. Add annotation so scheduler keeps them out of resv pools for 2h.

ops-tilly: Eviction command run: 
```
kubectl delete pod research-heavy-7b9f -n research --grace-period=30
kubectl delete pod research-heavy-8c2d -n research --grace-period=30
```
Pods terminated and restarted in shared-general pool.

maya: Node-level GPU usage dropped ~20% on resv nodes within 45s. Queue size started decreasing.

jordan: Autoscaler still failing to grow resv pool due to quota. Putting in urgent quota request with cloud provider now — ticket CLOUD-98765. ETA unknown.

zara (support): Notifying AcmeHealth support contact that we're diverting a portion of traffic to hosted fallback; asking to verify continuity. Message posted: "We're diverting a small percentage of your requests to our hosted cluster to reduce latency. We'll follow up when capacity is fully restored."

AcmeHealth (via support): "Seeing improvement, error rate dropping from 7% -> 1.5%. Thank you."

eli (oncall): Re-route config: added policy to smart-router: 
```
route(acmehealth) {
  fallback_cluster: hosted-west
  fallback_fraction: 0.12
  ttl: 30m
}
```
Verify logs for 502/504 anomalies.

maya: Monitoring shows queue at 18 and token latency back to SLO (p95 under 220ms).

jordan: Cloud quota ticket acknowledged, they said "investigating" and requested instance list — submitted. Meanwhile recommend keeping fallback active and do a graceful scale-down of long-running jobs in research namespace.

eli (oncall): Agreed. Jordan, please coordinate with Research team to throttle experiments. Ops-tilly, ensure eviction annotation remains for 2h.

ops-tilly: Annotation set: `redwood.io/evicted-from-resv: 2026-03-15T11:36:00Z` and taint applied to nodes to prevent reschedule into resv pool.

zara (support): Escalation note drafted for account team: high-impact incident, partial mitigation via fallback, customer saw improvement. We recommend follow-up call.

sre-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> customer impact reduced. Suggested postmortem checklist created.

eli (oncall): I'll keep the thread open until quota resolved and research jobs throttled. Handing off to Jordan for overnight watch. Jordan, you ok to take?

jordan: Taking handoff. Will check every 30m until quota uplift or until resv utilization stable <85% for 1h. Leaving reminder: @oncall-night for 00:00 UTC rotation.

maya: Leaving charts and query references: 
- GPU usage panel: `sum(gpu_util)% by node`
- Queue length: `sum(request_queue{pool=\"resv-east-1\"})`
- Autoscaler errors: logs tagged `autoscaler:scale_failed`

eli (oncall): Final: root cause prelim = noisy long-running experiments in reserved pool combined with autoscaler blocked by cloud quota. Immediate mitigations: eviction + fallback routing. Long-term: quota monitoring alert + enforce per-tenant GPU caps.

incident-bot: :checkered_flag: INCIDENT MITIGATED (partial). Thread will be closed after postmortem scheduled. Reference: CLOUD-98765 / PM-INC-2026-03-15-resv-exhaustion

jordan: I'll draft the postmortem and include mitigation timeline + recommendations. Closing handoff.
